## Supervision

Supervision is defined as 'overseeing the activities of participants,' (45). Estimates have indicated that approximately 80% of athletic injuries involve a lapse in supervision and/or instruction (5,6,37). One of the primary tasks of supervision is to ensure that safety practices are implemented by all concerned (7,8). In short, supervision is designed to prevent injuries due to inappropriate behaviors such as horseplay, daredevil-type stunts, and inattentiveness (31,32).
